I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100.

Ilse first posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. The same morning she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of both channels, so she can see both posts.

A seat count is account information rather than a money figure, so it was fine to share with someone on the account's team without approval.
